subject: Commercial Vacancy Tax Home Rule Petition
overview: The committee discussed a proposed Home Rule petition to grant the city authority to establish a commercial vacancy tax on unoccupied storefronts. The committee voted to keep the paper in committee and send the draft petition for legal review.

items.title: Commercial Vacancy Tax Home Rule Petition
items.summary: Councilor Leming introduced a draft Home Rule petition to authorize a commercial vacancy tax to discourage prolonged storefront vacancies, while Economic Development Director Di Stefano raised concerns regarding potential unintended consequences for small landlords and business perceptions. The committee voted to keep the matter in committee and refer the draft petition to legal counsel for review.
